A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the diquark model with the BS equation is a useful tool for the study of heavy baryon spectroscopy and weak decays of heavy baryons.
the diquark model for Lambda(Q) is consistent with the HQET to order m(Q), and that the corrections of order 1/mb to the form factors and decay widths are small, and are of order 10%.

the diquark model for Lambda(Q) is consistent with HQET at order 1/mQ, with the exception of the scalar form factors for the Lambda(Q)-->Lambda(Q') transitions, and that the predictions for Lambda(b) --> Lambda(c) transitions are consistent with experiment within the errors.
